Class StripeTransactionSelector

public inherited sharing class StripeTransactionSelector

Selector class for querying Stripe Transaction records. Provides methods for retrieving individual transactions, bulk transaction queries, and filtering transactions without associated payment authorizations.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    07/11/2021

Version:
    1.2


Change Log

  • 07/11/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 10/25/2025 - v1.1 - Added getTransaction() method to get a single transaction by ID
  • 10/27/2025 - v1.2 - Added getTransactionsWithoutPayments() method to get transactions without associated payments
  • 11/08/2025 - v1.3 - Method getTransaction() was bulkified and renamed to getTransactionsWithPaymentMethod()
